delivery_policy: Use ordinary official acquisition first. Transfer only custom material or a demonstrated retrieval gap; receiving-host execution and evidence interpretation remain distinct.
limits: Successful execution does not establish transcript correctness or semantic understanding.
A valid segment bounds flag establishes numeric containment only; preserve invalid raw times rather than silently clamping them.
Voice activity scores are optional and uncalibrated; music and singing require separate evaluation.
Historical installation acceptance does not prove continued sandbox residence.
No native subjective hearing, broad musical understanding, model parity, or complete five-provider rollout is claimed.
A useful assisted interpretation can still fail mandatory accuracy/provenance gates; correction is not a fresh independent trial.
